title: cooking-rs recipe
description: One recipe file under recipes/. Validated for real by `cargo test` (src/validate.rs); this schema is for editor autocomplete.

id.description: Must equal the file name without .json.

author.description: Who wrote the recipe ("Claude" for generated ones); drives the author filter.

image.description: Path relative to the repo root, e.g. images/<id>.svg. Must exist.

name.description: The ingredient as written. Matched against ingredients.json (key, name or alias) for the aisle, conversions and grocery merging; any name works.

unit.description: g, kg, ml, l, tsp, tbsp, cup, pcs, a piece label from the dictionary (clove, can…) or any piece word (bunch). Omit for a plain count ("2" eggs).

aisle.description: Grocery aisle for an ingredient the dictionary doesn't know (ignored otherwise); missing means Other.
